correctness.rationale: The 48x48 matrix and its orbit-sum matrices have verified exact rational ranks; the ample hyperplane lies in both spans, making Gram ranks equal dimensions. In ordinary p, nonzero Hasse coefficient bounds Picard rank by20. In supersingular p, the Hermitian finite map shows all quadratic-Frobenius eigenvalues on H² equal +p², the split-quadric count gives +p and -p multiplicities 12 and10, and the Katsura–Shioda supersingular rank-22 theorem shows these eigendirections are all algebraic; the odd-characteristic K3 Tate theorem supplies the arithmetic descent equivalence. All assertions hold for any odd prime, and the finite checker corroborates rather than substitutes.
